description: This file defines the 'Money' class, which encapsulates monetary amounts along with currency data. It provides methods for arithmetic operations, comparisons, rounding, and conversions related to monetary calculations within the Fineract project.

classes.name: Money
classes.description: Represents a monetary amount with associated currency, providing operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, rounding, and comparisons, ensuring correct handling of currency-specific rules.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency as a MonetaryCurrency object derived from the CurrencyData.

methods.name: getCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns the internal CurrencyData object.

methods.name: getCurrencyCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code as a String.

methods.name: getInMultiplesOf
methods.description: Returns the 'inMultiplesOf' value of the currency.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the monetary amount as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getAmountDefaultedToNullIfZero
methods.description: Returns the amount, defaulting to null if zero.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Calculates the sum of multiple Money instances provided either as an array or an iterable.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create Money instances from currency and amount, with optional MathContext.

methods.name: zero
methods.description: Creates a Money instance representing zero amount for a given currency.

methods.name: roundToMultiplesOf
methods.description: Rounds a given value (double, BigDecimal, or Money) to the nearest multiple specified.

methods.name: ceiling
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of a number to the nearest multiple.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Calculates the floor of a number to the nearest multiple.

methods.name: defaultToZeroIfNull
methods.description: Utility to replace null BigDecimal with BigDecimal.ZERO.

methods.name: defaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Utility to convert zero BigDecimal to null.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Money instance, optionally with a different amount.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Adds Money or BigDecimal amounts to this Money, returning a new instance.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Subtracts Money or BigDecimal amounts from this Money, returning a new instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds Money or BigDecimal amounts, similar to plus.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Subtracts BigDecimal amounts from this Money instance.

methods.name: checkCurrencyEqual
methods.description: Checks if another Money instance has the same currency; throws if not.

methods.name: isSameCurrency
methods.description: Checks if another Money instance has the same currency code.

methods.name: dividedBy
methods.description: Divides the monetary amount by a number, returning a new Money.

methods.name: multipliedBy
methods.description: Multiplies the monetary amount by a number, with optional MathContext.

methods.name: multiplyRetainScale
methods.description: Multiplies and retains scale as per currency's decimal places.

methods.name: percentageOf
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of the amount.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Money to another, ensuring same currency.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the amount is zero.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this Money amount equals another.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this amount is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this amount is greater than another.

methods.name: isLessThan
methods.description: Checks if this amount is less than another.

methods.name: isLessThanZero
methods.description: Checks if amount is less than zero.

methods.name: negated
methods.description: Returns a Money instance with negated amount.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the Money amount.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining currency code and amount.

methods.name: zero
methods.description: Returns Money of zero amount for current currency.
